title.en: How to count and combine chances
title.zh: 怎样数清并组合可能性

description.en: A probability is a share of an area. Slide over a table of counts to see “and”, “or”, “not” and “given” as pieces of one picture, and the one test for whether two things are independent.
description.zh: 概率就是一块面积所占的比例。在一张计数表上操作，把“并且”“或者”“不是”“已知”看成同一幅图的几块，以及判断两件事是否独立的那个唯一的检验。

name.zh: 概率：事件、条件概率、独立性

description.en: Confusing P(A | B) with P(B | A)
description.zh: 把 P(A | B) 和 P(B | A) 搞反

description.en: Adding P(A) and P(B) for “A or B” without subtracting the overlap
description.zh: 算“A 或 B”时把 P(A) 和 P(B) 直接相加，没有减去重叠

title.en: A police force, as a picture
title.zh: 把一支警察队伍画成图

text.en: A police force has 1,200 officers: 960 men and 240 women. Over two years 324 were promoted: 288 men and 36 women. The picture is the whole force as a rectangle: columns by sex (a column is as wide as its group), and each column split into promoted and not promoted. Choose what **A** and **B** mean, and read the probabilities off the areas.
text.zh: 一支警察队伍有 1,200 名警官：960 名男性、240 名女性。两年里有 324 人获晋升：288 名男性、36 名女性。这幅图把整支队伍画成一个长方形：按性别分列（每列的宽度和这一组的人数成比例），每一列再分成晋升和未晋升。选好 **A** 和 **B** 是什么，从面积读出概率。

alt.en: The police force as an area: choose events A and B and read their probabilities off the picture.
alt.zh: 把警察队伍画成面积：选事件 A 和 B，从图上读它们的概率。

caption.en: Choose A (promoted) and B (women). Then press “Given B”: only B stays, and its own total becomes the new whole.
caption.zh: 选 A（晋升）和 B（女性）。再按“已知 B”：只留下 B，它自己的总数成为新的整体。

prompt.en: Overall, 27% of officers were promoted. Among the **women**, what share was promoted?
prompt.zh: 全体警官里 27% 获晋升。**女性**里获晋升的比例是多少？

label.en: 15%: 36 of the 240 women. Lower than 27%, so being a woman and being promoted are not independent.
label.zh: 15%：240 名女性里有 36 人。低于 27%，所以“是女性”和“获晋升”不独立。

feedback.en: That is P(woman and promoted), the overlap. “Among the women” restricts to the 240.
feedback.zh: 那是 P(女性且晋升)，即重叠部分。“女性里”要把范围缩到这 240 人。

feedback.en: Only if the two were independent. Check on the picture: the women’s promoted slice is thinner.
feedback.zh: 只有当两者独立时才是。看图：女性那一列里晋升的那条更薄。

explain.en: “Given B” means: throw away everything outside B and divide by B’s own total. 36/240 against 324/1200.
explain.zh: “已知 B”的意思是：把 B 以外的全部扔掉，除以 B 自己的总数。36/240 对 324/1200。

text.en: Three ways to *get* a probability, which the exam can name: **classical** (all outcomes equally likely: a die, $1/6$ each), **relative frequency** (from data: the X-ray department had 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 patients waiting on 2, 5, 6, 4, 3 of 20 days, so $f = 0.10, 0.25, 0.30, 0.20, 0.15$) and **subjective** (a degree of belief: Tom puts 0.6 on his offer being accepted, Judy 0.8). Every probability is between 0 and 1 and the outcomes’ probabilities add to 1. Counting rules help with equally likely outcomes: three steps with 2 outcomes each give $2 \times 2 \times 2 = 8$; choosing 2 of 5 parts gives $\binom{5}{2} = 10$ combinations.
text.zh: *得到*概率有三种办法，考试可能会点名：**经典法**（所有结果等可能：一颗骰子，每面 $1/6$）、**相对频率法**（来自数据：X 光科 20 天里有 2、5、6、4、3 天分别有 0、1、2、3、4 位病人在等，所以 $f = 0.10, 0.25, 0.30, 0.20, 0.15$）和**主观法**（信念的程度：Tom 认为他的报价被接受的概率是 0.6，Judy 认为是 0.8）。每个概率都在 0 和 1 之间，各个结果的概率加起来是 1。计数规则帮你处理等可能的结果：三步、每步 2 个结果，共 $2 \times 2 \times 2 = 8$ 种；从 5 个零件里选 2 个，有 $\binom{5}{2} = 10$ 种组合。

body.en: Mutually exclusive events *depend* on each other as much as possible: if one happens, the other cannot. Independent events do not affect each other at all.
body.zh: 互斥的事件彼此*依赖*到了极点：一个发生，另一个就不可能发生。独立的事件则完全互不影响。

prompt.en: At a software company 30% of employees left because of salary, 20% because of their work assignment, and 12% gave **both** as reasons. What is the probability that an employee left for salary **or** work assignment (or both)?
prompt.zh: 一家软件公司里，30% 的员工因薪水离职，20% 因工作安排离职，12% 的人两个原因**都**有。一名员工因薪水**或**工作安排（或两者）离职的概率是多少？

explain.en: $0.30 + 0.20 - 0.12 = 0.38$. The 12% who gave both are counted once, not twice. The probability of neither is $1 - 0.38 = 0.62$.

prompt.en: Of the employees who left because of work assignment, what share also gave salary as a reason? That is $P(S \mid W)$.
prompt.zh: 因工作安排离职的员工里，也把薪水当作原因的占多少？也就是 $P(S \mid W)$。

explain.en: $P(S \mid W) = P(S \cap W)/P(W) = 0.12/0.20 = 0.60$. Not $P(W \mid S) = 0.12/0.30 = 0.40$: the order matters.

title.en: Another table: why MBA students chose their school
title.zh: 另一张表：MBA 学生为什么选这所学校

text.en: 1,929 MBA students gave the first reason for applying to the school they joined. Is the reason independent of whether they study full time or part time?
text.zh: 1,929 名 MBA 学生说了他们申请所读学校的首要原因。这个原因和他们读全日制还是非全日制有关系吗？

alt.en: MBA students by study mode and first reason for choosing a school.
alt.zh: MBA 学生按学习方式和选校首要原因的分类。

caption.en: Let A be “quality” and B be “full time”, then compare P(A | B) with P(A).
caption.zh: 设 A 为“质量”，B 为“全日制”，然后比较 P(A | B) 和 P(A)。

title.zh: 全日制学生和学校质量

prompt.en: If a student is full time, what is the probability that school quality is the first reason? (Three decimals.)
prompt.zh: 如果一名学生是全日制，学校质量是首要原因的概率是多少？（三位小数）

explain.en: $421/890 = 0.473$. For part-time students it is $400/1039 = 0.385$; overall $821/1929 = 0.426$. Since $0.473 \ne 0.426$, the first reason and the study mode are **dependent**.

prompt.en: Which statement is the correct test for two events $F$ and $Q$ being independent?
prompt.zh: 哪一句是检验两个事件 $F$ 和 $Q$ 独立的正确方法？

label.en: $P(Q \mid F) = P(Q)$: knowing $F$ leaves the chance of $Q$ unchanged.
label.zh: $P(Q \mid F) = P(Q)$：知道 $F$ 并不改变 $Q$ 的可能性。

feedback.en: These two are usually different, and equal only by accident.
feedback.zh: 这两个通常不同，相等只是巧合。

explain.zh: 独立的意思是加上条件什么也不会改变。

body.en: $P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)$. Adding only the first two counts the overlap twice.
body.zh: $P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)$。只加前两项会把重叠算两次。

body.en: In $P(A \mid B)$ you divide by $P(B)$, **not** by the size of the whole group. This is the same move you will use for Bayes’ theorem in lesson 11.
body.zh: $P(A \mid B)$ 要除以 $P(B)$，**不是**除以整个群体的大小。这和第 11 课的贝叶斯定理是同一个动作。

prompt.en: In lesson 11 the posterior $P(\text{strong} \mid \text{favourable})$ will be a conditional probability. Which total is its denominator?
prompt.zh: 第 11 课里的后验 $P(\text{强} \mid \text{有利})$ 是个条件概率。它的分母是哪个总数？

label.en: $P(\text{favourable})$: the overall chance of the report.

feedback.en: The condition is the report, so its probability is the denominator.
feedback.zh: 条件是报告，所以分母是它的概率。

feedback.en: Only when the report is certain.
feedback.zh: 只有当报告是必然的时候。

explain.en: Conditioning on the report: divide by the report’s probability.
explain.zh: 以报告为条件：除以报告的概率。

prompt.en: Two suppliers both deliver in 10.3 days on average, with s = 0.67 and s = 2.58. The more reliable one has:
prompt.zh: 两个供应商平均交货都是 10.3 天，标准差分别是 0.67 和 2.58。更可靠的那个是：

feedback.zh: 离散程度越大越不可预测。

label.en: Cannot say: the means are equal.

feedback.en: Equal means is exactly when the spread decides.
feedback.zh: 平均数相等时，恰恰要靠离散程度来决定。

explain.en: Smaller s with the same mean means more consistent.
explain.zh: 平均数相同，s 越小越稳定。
